    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Comforting Presence](/Feats.aspx?ID=5244) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Emotion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=60" />
<trait label="General" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=78" />
<trait label="Mental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=106" />
<trait label="Skill" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=144" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #197: Let the Leaves Fall](/Sources.aspx?ID=222) pg. 70

**Prerequisites**
Master in [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=44)

**Trigger**
An adjacent ally becomes fightened or stupefied

</column>

---

You use your occult connection to your allies to take on the fear and confusion they feel. Focus on your own calmness and pull in your nearby allies' emotions. Reduce the [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) and [stupefied ](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94)condition values of adjacent allies by 1, and increase your frightened and stupefied condition values by the same amount.
name: Comforting Presence
primary_source_raw: Pathfinder #197: Let the Leaves Fall pg. 70
